description: This file is a Perl script used for flashing and configuring D-Link DSL-502T routers, specifically interacting with their bootloader via network protocols, verifying firmware signatures, adjusting environment variables like MTD settings, and performing firmware updates.
published: main code execution block (not assigned to a symbol but encapsulated in script)

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with customized methods for interacting specifically with the ADAM2 bootloader on D-Link DSL routers, including login, getenv, and reboot functionalities.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server to authenticate.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the router via FTP command GETENV.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to access environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends a reboot command to the router.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device, closing FTP connection afterward.
